definitions.explanation: The unrefined or rough portion of something.

examples.english: To look for faults in others.

examples.japanese: {粗|あら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{目立|めだ}つ→目立つ：02431_medatsu⟧。
⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{粗|あら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{指摘|してき}する→指摘：05630_shiteki⟧。
examples.english: To point out the flaws in the plan.

examples.japanese: {粗|あら}⟦{探|さが}し→探す：00493_sagasu⟧ばかりしないで。

examples.english: To make stock from fish trimmings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{粗|あら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えてきた→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: The flaws in the work became visible.

examples.japanese: ⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{粗|あら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{除|のぞ}く→取り除く：04222_torinozoku⟧。
examples.english: To remove the coarse parts from the rice.

examples.japanese: {粗|あら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}ない→出る：00513_deru⟧ように⟦{気|き}をつける→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧。
examples.english: Be careful not to let flaws show.
To remove the rough parts of the vegetables.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{粗|あら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つけた→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧。
⟦{大根|だいこん}→大根：05186_daikon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{粗|あら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{除|のぞ}く→取り除く：04222_torinozoku⟧。
examples.english: To carefully remove the coarse parts from the daikon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{粗|あら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{味噌汁|みそしる}→味噌汁：04954_misoshiru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦おいしい→おいしい：00740_oishii⟧。
examples.english: Miso soup made with fish trimmings is very delicious.

notes:
{粗|あら} refers to faults or rough parts.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {粗|あら}を{探|さが}す (to look for faults)
- {粗|あら}が{見|み}える (flaws become visible)
- {粗|あら}{探|さが}し (fault-finding)

RELATED WORDS:
- {粗|あら}い: rough, coarse (adjective)
- {欠点|けってん}: fault, shortcoming
- {粗末|そまつ}: poor quality, crude
